subject: HTML link to local file (used by another address)

messages.author: 102e805b96e49e14
messages.subject: HTML link to local file (used by another address)
parts:
Hello,

Due to my ignorance I don't really know how to describe this in the topic... But what I'd like to do is use this "https://designer.genomecompiler.com/plasmid_iframe?file_url=" to read a file in the local shiny directory, and cannot find the correct syntax. I'm using Firefox.

This example line works fine in the UI.R:
tags$a(href='https://designer.genomecompiler.com/plasmid_iframe?file_url=http://s3.amazonaws.com/gcc_production/plasmid_viewer/OG34_OG34_pSF-OXB19.gb', target='blank', 'plasmid1')

But when I try to point it to a a local file (in the 'www' or the root shiny app folder, because the plan is to deploy the app) it gives an 'error loading file (internal server error)':
tags$a(href='https://designer.genomecompiler.com/plasmid_iframe?file_url=CTER_pFA6a-2PA-CTAP-KanMX6.gcproj', target='blank', 'plasmid1')

Can this be done, or do I need to upload the file to a web repository?

Thank you in advance!
Ruben
